paragraphs: Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati: Berakhot 12b; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads R' Avin bar Zutrati.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Berakhot 12b paragraph fully names Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati. The separate Avin/bar variant remains Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim report and its uncollated title remains R' in the new body; the two names and ben/bar forms are not harmonized.
